description: One domain in the latest zone. Returns one record, or an error when there is no match. Fields: domain (varchar): Domain name, lower-case; tld (varchar): se or nu; nameservers (varchar[]): NS host names; glue_v4 (varchar[]): In-zone glue A records; glue_v6 (varchar[]): In-zone glue AAAA records; has_ds (boolean): DNSSEC signed delegation; ds_algorithms (integer[]): DNSSEC algorithm numbers; serial (bigint): Zone serial the row comes from; fetched_at (timestamptz): When the zone was transferred.
